Transport Coordinator

We are looking for a responsible, flexible, and service-minded Transport Coordinator to join our team in Denmark.

The position combines transport coordination, administrative duties, customer service, driving vehicles, and general vehicle management. The successful candidate must be willing to perform both office-based and practical tasks as part of daily operations.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Plan and coordinate daily transport activities, driving schedules, and driver assignments.

• 
Drive company vehicles including transporting customers.

• 
Handle daily communication, queries, complaints, and operational issues with customers, drivers, and ride-hailing platforms.

• 
Manage driver and vehicle accounts, registrations, documentation, and follow-ups with transport platforms.

• 
Handle trip-related disputes, payment issues, cancellations, and customer feedback.

• 
Maintain transport records, schedules, reports, and other administrative documentation.

• 
Ensure company vehicles are clean and ready for operation, including regular interior and exterior cleaning.

• 
Check vehicles for general condition, cleanliness, fuel levels, and report any defects or maintenance requirements.

• 
Assist with vehicle servicing, inspections, car washes, vehicle transfers, and other practical assignments.

• 
Perform general administrative and operational tasks as required.

Requirements

• 
Valid driving licence and good driving experience.

• 
Willingness to drive company vehicles as part of daily work.

• 
Good communication and customer service skills.

• 
Basic computer skills and knowledge of office software.

• 
Good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks.

• 
Maintain accounting and book log for the activities.

• 
Good English communication skills. Danish is an advantage.

• 
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

We Offer

• 
Stable and professional working environment.

• 
Full-time employment.

• 
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.

• 
Varied responsibilities combining administration, driving, and transport operations.

• 
Opportunities for professional development.

 

Transportkoordinator

Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst, fleksibel og serviceminded transportkoordinator til vores team i Danmark.

Stillingen kombinerer transportkoordinering, administrative opgaver, kundeservice, kørsel og generel håndtering af virksomhedens køretøjer. Den rette kandidat skal være indstillet på både kontorarbejde og praktiske opgaver som en del af den daglige drift.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområder

• 
Planlægning og koordinering af daglige transportopgaver, kørselsplaner og chaufførfordeling.

• 
Køre erhvervsmæssig persontransport herunder transport af kunder.

• 
Daglig kommunikation og håndtering af forespørgsler, klager og driftsmæssige problemer fra kunder, chauffører og kørselsplatforme.

• 
Administration af chauffør- og køretøjskonti, registreringer, dokumentation og opfølgning på transportplatforme.

• 
Håndtering af tvister vedrørende ture, betalingsproblemer, aflysninger og kundefeedback.

• 
Vedligeholdelse af transportregistre, kørselsplaner, rapporter og anden administrativ dokumentation.

• 
Sikring af, at virksomhedens biler er rene og klar til brug, herunder regelmæssig indvendig og udvendig rengøring.

• 
Kontrol af bilernes generelle stand, renlighed og brændstofniveau samt rapportering af fejl og behov for vedligeholdelse.

• 
Hjælp med serviceeftersyn, syn, bilvask, flytning af køretøjer og andre praktiske opgaver.

• 
Vedligeholdelse af regnskabsregistreringer og kørsels- og aktivitetslog for transportaktiviteterne.

• 
Udførelse af øvrige administrative og driftsmæssige opgaver efter behov.

Kvalifikationer

• 
Gyldigt kørekort og god køreerfaring.

• 
Villighed til at køre erhv. Persontransport som en del af det daglige arbejde.

• 
Gode kommunikations- og kundeserviceevner.

• 
Grundlæggende IT-færdigheder og kendskab til almindelige kontorprogrammer.

• 
Gode organisatoriske evner og evne til at håndtere flere opgaver samtidigt.

• 
Evne til at føre regnskabsregistreringer og aktivitetslog.

• 
Gode engelskkundskaber. Dansk er en fordel.

• 
Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt og som en del af et team.

Vi tilbyder

Et stabilt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø.

• 
Fuldtidsansættelse.

• 
Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

• 
En alsidig stilling med administrative opgaver, kørsel og transportdrift.

• 
Muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Do you like to create structure, improving processes, and turning data into decisions?

At Original Coffee, we are looking for an analytical and structured Production & Supply Planner to strengthen our production planning across our bakery and coffee roastery.

This is a newly created position where you will have the opportunity to shape processes, improve efficiency, and ensure production aligns with demand while keeping inventory, costs, and resources under control.

You will work closely with our Production, Operations, Wholesale, and Finance teams, turning data and insights into practical improvements.

About us

Original Coffee (OC) is a growing company with 22 coffee shops around Copenhagen. We invite our guests to pause, refocus, and connect—both with themselves and with others. From the moment they walk through our doors, our mission is to create a memorable experience: freshly baked goods from our own bakery, exceptional coffee from our own roastery, and outstanding service. Together, that’s what we call the OC experience!

In OC it all starts with people – our guests, our team, and our partners. We believe that putting people first creates the foundation for strong communities, great experiences, and coffee worth coming back for!

Your responsibilities

As our Production & Supply Planner, you will help build a structured, data-driven approach to production planning.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Production planning: Develop and maintain production plans based on demand, sales, seasonality, and capacity.

• Forecasting: Analyze data and forecast future production needs.

• Inventory management: Monitor stock and optimize inventory.

• Cost calculations: Calculate and maintain accurate product costs in collaboration with our production and Finance.

• Process optimisation: Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve productivity, and optimise resources.

• Data & reporting: Develop reports and analyses to support our business.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Coordinate planning across the bakery, roastery, logistics, and other departments.

You won't be responsible for managing daily production but will act as a key partner to our production teams, helping shape how we plan and improve our processes.

Who are you?

We imagine you have experience in production planning, supply chain, inventory management, or a similar field.

Ideally, you:

• Have 3 years experience with production planning, forecasting, or supply planning.

• Are analytical, structured, and confident working with numbers.

• Have strong Excel skills and preferably experience with ERP or planning systems.

• Understand inventory management, production costs, and cost calculations.

• Can turn data into actionable improvements.

• Take ownership, work independently, and enjoy collaborating across teams.

Experience in food production is an advantage, but what matters most is your analytical mindset and motivation to make things better.

What do we offer?

At Original Coffee, you'll join a passionate team dedicated to great coffee, quality products, and memorable experiences.

We offer:

• Create the role with the opportunity to make a real impact.

• The freedom to develop and improve processes.

• Close collaboration with dedicated colleagues across our bakery, roastery, and HQ.

• A role combining analysis, operations, and business development.

• An informal workplace with short decision-making processes and room for new ideas.

You will report to our CFO and work closely with our production teams and Finance.

Sounds like something for you?

We would love to hear from you!

**Specialist, Lifecycle Programs - CRM focused

**Do you want to build customer journeys that engage customers across their lifecycle?

We are looking for a hands-on lifecycle professional to help Pandora build, maintain and optimise automated customer programs in Bloomreach. As Specialist, Lifecycle Programs, you will translate approved strategies, briefs and playbooks into reliable CRM customer journeys in Bloomreach. You will work closely with the Lifecycle team, markets, Analytics, Digital & Technology and external partners to deliver high-quality lifecycle programs consistently and at scale.

**What You Will Do

**Together with the team, you will help turn our lifecycle strategy into high-quality, scalable customer experiences in Bloomreach. Your focus will be hands-on CRM implementation, quality execution and continuous optimisation.

**Build and deliver lifecycle programs

**

• Translate approved briefs and playbooks into segmentation, targeting and Bloomreach scenario setups.

• Build, deploy and maintain automated lifecycle programs across email and other relevant CRM channels.

• Support the rollout and localisation of lifecycle initiatives across markets.

**Ensure quality and optimise performance

**

• Test scenarios end to end and ensure they follow agreed templates, QA standards, contact strategy and suppression rules.

• Monitor live programs, troubleshoot implementation issues and contribute to clear documentation and handovers.

• Use performance insights and test results to improve targeting, timing, messaging and journey logic.

**Collaborate and share expertise

**

• Work closely with Lifecycle colleagues, markets, Analytics, Digital & Technology and external partners to deliver programs effectively.

• Provide hands-on Bloomreach support and share reusable solutions and learnings across the team.

• Contribute to improving templates, documentation and ways of working.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• Accurate and reliable lifecycle implementations.

• Consistent use of agreed standards, templates and QA controls.

• Faster and more efficient delivery across markets.

• Clear documentation and effective handovers.

• Improved customer engagement, conversion, lifecycle progression and repeat-purchase outcomes.

**To succeed in this role, you have

**

• Typically 2-4 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing or marketing automation.

• Practical hands-on experience with Bloomreach Engagement or a comparable marketing automation platform.

• Experience building automated customer journeys and applying segmentation, targeting and audience logic.

• An understanding of testing, QA and lifecycle program optimisation.

• Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.

• The ability to collaborate effectively across business, technology, markets and external partners.

• The judgement to recognise and escalate complex implementation or governance questions.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

**Why join us?

**You will join Pandora’s global Customer Lifecycle & Membership team and help turn lifecycle strategy into customer experiences that can be scaled across markets.

The role gives you the opportunity to develop deep hands-on Bloomreach expertise, contribute to global lifecycle programs and help improve the standards, templates and ways of working that support our continued growth.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band 5B

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Scientist for formulation and high throughput assay development
jobs.description:
Do you want to apply your skills within drug discovery and help turn new molecules into new drug products? We are looking for a motivated Scientist to support our drug discovery pipeline within Pharmaceutical Development in our Biotech unit at Gubra.

As our new Scientist, you will take ownership for physicochemical characterization of peptides including development and maintenance of our high throughput plate-based assays. You will be part of both our Pharmaceutical Development department and our cross-departmental drug discovery project teams contributing to study planning and data interpretation to progress our molecules through the discovery and development pipeline. You will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians across Gubra.

Your new department

The Pharmaceutical Development department supports Gubra’s drug discovery & development projects by delivering physicochemical characterization, formulation development and analytical development and support for novel peptide drug candidates. Our department is involved all the way from early drug discovery, through to supporting Gubra’s CMC department when our projects go into clinical development. We are currently 5 scientists and 5 laboratory technicians in the department.

Key responsibilities

• Act as the Pharmaceutical Development lead scientist in drug discovery projects setting the scientific direction for designing, interpreting, and reporting studies from early drug discovery all the way to supporting clinical development.

• Responsible for setting up and developing new high-throughput plate-based assays to support discovery and development of new drug candidates.

• Evaluate physicochemical stability of peptides using high-throughput plate-based assays (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS) and/or HPLC and MS.

• Drive early-stage formulation development for new drug candidates.

• Identify opportunities for automatization and optimization of our laboratory workflows and develop improvements in close collaboration with laboratory technicians and scientists.

Core competencies and qualifications

We imagine you have solid experience with and a strong interest in assay development for physicochemical characterization of peptides. You have knowledge and experience within early formulation development for peptides. You enjoy collaborating with laboratory technicians and scientists with different backgrounds and you thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• A PhD or master’s degree within biochemistry, chemistry, pharmaceutics, engineering, or similar.

• 3+ years relevant experience within drug discovery or development projects.

• Experience with different assay methods for peptides (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS or others).

• Experience with coordination of laboratory tasks and close collaboration with laboratory technicians.

• Propose new scientific ideas, take initiative to move agreed work forward, and involve colleagues in developing and implementing improvements.

• Great execution and collaboration skills.

• Experience with communicating study plans, scientific findings and uncertainties clearly to scientists and laboratory technicians, adapting explanations to the audience and checking shared understanding.

As a person you are

• Keen to take on responsibility and take the lead.

• Proactive and good at initiating and delivering on new projects and following up on new ideas.

• Keen on collaborating across departmental workflows, sharing relevant knowledge and contributing to agreed priorities within your role and expertise.

• Able to adapt plans when priorities change, clarify expectations with colleagues and communicate the implications for ongoing work.

We offer

Gubra Biotech is a project-centric organization, and you will work in cross-functional teams on our drug discovery projects. As a Scientist representing Pharmaceutical Development, you will provide scientific recommendations within your discipline and agreed project priorities, working together with scientists from other study disciplines including Chemistry, Molecular Pharmacology, Translational Pharmacology, DMPK, and Computational Drug Discovery.

We are expanding our capabilities, and you will have the opportunity to impact what new methods and workflows that Pharmaceutical Development needs.

You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to share your ideas, learn from colleagues and drive projects forward while growing professionally.

Contact and application

Please apply no later than November 29th, 2026, by uploading your motivated cover letter, resume and relevant diplomas on our website. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Senior Department Manager Natashia Mai Yde Jacobsen at nyj@gubra.dk.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently – and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 300 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

Job title: Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology, you will help build a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research that generates and validates therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. You will combine hands-on rodent pharmacology with original scientific thinking, shaping research questions and turning emerging biology into opportunities for drug discovery. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in pharmacology, physiology, neuroscience or a related discipline, or bring equivalent relevant research experience. You also bring:

• At least two years of relevant post-PhD experience with scientific innovation, or equivalent scientific contributions.

• Hands-on experience in rodent pharmacology.

• Strong skills in experimental design, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex biological data.

• Scientific depth in metabolic physiology, neuroscience, in vitro pharmacology, or a related area.

• Original scientific thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to turn ideas into testable hypotheses.

• A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently while contributing to shared research goals.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience in metabolic phenotyping, advanced behavioural assays, rodent surgery, modern neuroscience methods, in vitro or ex vivo approaches, or developing novel experimental technologies. We welcome complementary profiles – you are not expected to bring expertise in every method or scientific area.

**What You Will Do

**You will contribute to both the scientific direction and hands-on experimental work of the team. Your responsibilities will include:

• Generate hypotheses and propose new therapeutic concepts grounded in biological understanding.

• Design, conduct, analyse and interpret mouse and rat pharmacology studies to investigate efficacy, mechanism of action and physiological responses.

• Develop experimental models and introduce methodologies that enable us to address challenging scientific questions.

• Connect in vivo findings with relevant in vitro and ex vivo experiments.

• Integrate evidence into recommendations on how emerging concepts should advance, change direction or be discontinued.

• Document and communicate findings, sharing scientific insights across disciplines and project teams.

• Contribute to rigorous, reproducible experimental practice and high standards of animal welfare.

All scientists are expected to contribute directly to experimental work alongside laboratory technicians and fellow scientists.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape the research of a new team and contribute your own ideas, in an environment that values thoughtful scientific challenge, collaboration and learning from unexpected findings.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into new therapeutic concepts, apply for the Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology role by 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating an exceptional employee experience and enabling business performance? Then this could be your next opportunity at Louis Nielsen and Specsavers.

Join us as our new Head of P&O for Louis Nielsen and take responsibility for a people agenda spanning two distinct parts of our business: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. As a trusted business partner to the Country Leadership Team, you'll help shape organisational success by translating people priorities into meaningful business outcomes while leading a skilled, supportive and caring P&O team.

Your role

As Head of P&O, you will lead the local P&O team and people agenda for Louis Nielsen in Denmark. The role has two important dimensions.

For our Support Office, you will work closely with the Country Director and management team as a strategic P&O partner. You will help shape the organisation, leadership and employee experience needed to deliver the business plan, including organisational change, talent and performance, recruitment and onboarding, leadership development and engagement.

For our Retail organisation, you will ensure that the P&O team provides relevant and effective support to our stores and retail leaders. This includes strengthening the P&O services, processes and guidance available to stores, particularly within employee relations, employee experience and core people processes.

Across both areas, you will lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll and connect Louis Nielsen with the wider Northern Europe P&O organisation, translating regional and global priorities into locally relevant delivery.

Your key responsibilities

Partnering with our Support Office:

• Partner with the Country Director and management team to shape and deliver the people agenda and local business plan.

• Advise and coach leaders on organisation, leadership, talent, performance and people-related matters.

• Lead organisational change and support leaders and colleagues through change.

• Ensure strong recruitment and onboarding, talent and performance processes, and development planning across the Support Office.

• Drive employee engagement, including Great Place to Work, action planning and follow-up.

Enabling our Retail organisation:

• Ensure that retail leaders and stores have access to relevant and effective P&O services and support.

• Support the continued development and delivery of HR services to stores, including employee relations and employee experience guidance.

• Ensure that core people processes and policies are practical, consistent and effective within our retail environment.

• Work closely with retail leadership to identify emerging people needs and translate them into appropriate P&O solutions.

Leading P&O and connecting with Northern Europe:

• Lead and develop the local P&O team, including payroll, creating clarity, capability and strong delivery.

• Represent Denmark within the Northern Europe P&O team and contribute to the Northern Europe People Plan.

• Translate relevant regional and global people priorities into strong local delivery.

• Partner with regional P&O colleagues across business partnering, learning and development, and operational excellence.

• Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects in Denmark and across Northern Europe.

Your new team

You'll lead the Danish People & Organisation team of six people while being part of the wider Northern Europe P&O function.

The team supports two distinct parts of Louis Nielsen: our Support Office and our nationwide retail organisation. The nature of that support differs, and an important part of your role will be ensuring that our P&O model meets the needs of both.

Within the Support Office, the team works closely with leaders and colleagues across the full employee lifecycle. For Retail, the focus is on providing scalable, effective P&O services, processes and guidance that enable our retail leaders and stores to succeed. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the Northern Europe P&O function.

What are we looking for?

“We are looking for someone who genuinely cares about our people, builds trust, and understands everyday life in our stores and Support Office. Someone who offers practical support and keeps things simple and efficient, freeing up time for meaningful conversations, development and looking ahead. You’ll help shape the people agenda in Denmark—and I look forward to working alongside you and our colleagues across Northern Europe, sharing ideas and supporting one another.”_

- Malene Green Brostrøm, People Director Northern Europe

Preferably our candidates will have some of the following competencies:

• Significant HR leadership experience within a complex, matrix organisation.

• Experience acting as a strategic People partner to senior business leaders.

• Experience balancing strategic business partnering with the delivery of scalable and effective HR services across different employee populations.

• A strong track record of leading organisational change and transformation initiatives.

• Experience linking business strategy, people priorities, and employee engagement outcomes.

• Experience working within an international environment.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coaching, and influencing skills.

• Strong leadership experience with a proven ability to develop high-performing teams.

• The ability to move comfortably between strategic business partnering and ensuring strong, pragmatic P&O delivery.

It would be an advantage if you have:

• Experience within retail, consumer goods, or other customer-facing multi-site environments.

• Experience working across multiple countries or markets.

• Knowledge of employment relations and organisational change programmes.

• Experience leading cross-functional projects in an international organisation.

As a person, we believe that you are:

• An inspiring leader who develops and motivates others.

• A trusted advisor who builds credibility and strong relationships at all levels.

• Commercially minded and able to connect people priorities with business performance.

• Structured and resilient, with the ability to navigate complexity and change.

• A collaborative communicator who engages stakeholders across functions and geographies.

What awaits you upon joining Louis Nielsen

At Louis Nielsen and Specsavers, you'll get more than just a job. You'll join an organisation with a clear purpose: changing lives through better sight and hearing.

We offer an exciting and influential leadership role where you'll play a key part in shaping the future of our people agenda in Denmark.

Joining us, you’ll get:

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• Significant exposure to senior business leaders and strategic decision-making.

• An international and collaborative work environment.

• The chance to make a meaningful impact on both people and business performance.

• A culture built on trust, inclusion, and continuous development.

Your base will be at Louis Nielsen’s Support Office in Aalborg, but we take a very flexible approach to where you work. Finding the right person matters more to us than where in Denmark you live. You should, however, expect to spend a couple of days in Aalborg each week.

Is this your next step? Then apply today

To apply, please send us your CV using the button below. We want to respect your time, so including an application letter is optional. Feel free to apply as soon as possible. Please avoid including any photos or references to your age in your CV. It contributes to a fairer and more unbiased assessment.

We review CVs and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. Our recruitment process typically consists of an initial screening, two rounds of interviews, and a personality assessment feedback session.

Diversity & Inclusion at Specsavers

Specsavers will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected factor.

In line with our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we integrate these principles into all aspects of our work, from product development to team building.

Department: Dynamics 365 F&O UO

**HSO is a global business transformation partner where innovation, AI, and Microsoft technology come together. With 30+ years of Microsoft expertise, 3,000 employees worldwide, 2,000+ clients, and 7,500+ projects delivered, we help organizations unlock the full potential of the Microsoft Cloud.

Recognized as a Microsoft AI Business Solutions Inner Circle Partner for 22 consecutive years and a Microsoft Frontier Partner, HSO is among the top Microsoft partners driving AI-powered transformation worldwide.

**About HSO International

**At HSO International, you'll join a diverse team of 300+ professionals representing more than 50 nationalities. We deliver cross-border transformation programs for international customers, combining local expertise with global reach in a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: Life at HSO International

**As a D365 Finance Lead Consultant, you work with Microsoft Dynamics 365, the Azure cloud platform, and our unique, industry-specific solutions to develop the best strategy for a digital transformation and design, implement, and manage innovative cloud solutions for our customers. You will lead the Finance workstream of a complex multinational Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations transformation.

**

• Lead the Finance workstream across international Dynamics 365 programs.

• Advise Finance leaders and key stakeholders on processes, operating models, and technology decisions.

• Lead discovery and design workshops, challenge existing processes, and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and efficiency.

**Own Finance Solution Design

**

• Ensure Finance solutions work across countries, legal entities, and business units.

• Partner with Solution Architects and other workstreams across integrations, data, testing, and deployment.

**Lead the Workstream

**

• Guide Finance consultants on priorities, dependencies, risks, and key decisions.

• Act as a senior point of contact for the customer Finance team.

• Mentor consultants and maintain quality across Finance deliverables.

**

• Contribute to HSO Finance methodologies, accelerators, and best practices.

• Identify opportunities to apply Copilot, AI, automation, Power Platform, and analytics to Finance transformation.

**

• At least 10 years of ERP consulting experience with significant Finance expertise.

• Several years of experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and multi-industry project experience.

• Experience leading a Finance workstream or taking senior functional ownership on complex implementations.

• Strong Finance process, workshop facilitation, solution design, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience with international or enterprise-scale transformations and mentoring consultants.

• Familiarity with Power Platform, Azure, analytics, automation, AI, Copilot, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.

• Strong English communication skills and a collaborative, commercially minded approach.

**What You’ll Gain

**

• Global impact: lead Finance transformation across countries, regions, legal entities, and business units.

• Leadership: take greater ownership while remaining close to Finance, technology, and delivery.

• Freedom: influence solution direction and shape your role around your strengths.

• Innovation: help define how AI, automation, and Copilot change Finance and consulting delivery.

• Growth and flexibility: learn from experienced Dynamics 365 professionals and work from anywhere in Europe.

**Location

Corti builds AI for critical industries. We started in healthcare, where messy inputs, specialized knowledge, and consequential errors make demanding engineering problems unavoidable. Today we train and post-train models, build agents, and turn research into APIs that developers use to build their products. Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

We are building Europe’s alternative to closed AI: ambitious model development, published research, and AI infrastructure that gives developers control over the systems they depend on.

Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

The Role

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

What You Will Do

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

• 
Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

Who you are

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.

• 
You know post-training methods from the inside.Preference optimisation and reinforcement learning have quirks, reward hacking, runs that look stable until they collapse, and signals that turns out to be noise. You have hit these problems and learned to spot them before they cost you a week.

• 
You have hands-on experience with the data the models learn from. You have built training-data pipelines, ideally synthetic ones, and stayed close to the training that consumed your data.

• 
You have evaluated LLMs in production. You have built and calibrated LLM-as-judge systems to automate that evaluation, and you know when a judge's score means something and when it just flatters the model it is scoring.

• 
You also have the itch to investigate. A new model, paper, or agent framework appears, and you want to understand what actually changed. You build experiments, compare approaches, and test the claims. Perhaps your latest side project involves agents building tools, coordinating with other agents, or failing in a surprisingly instructive way. We want to hear about it.

• 
A relevant advanced degree is welcome; equivalent experience matters just as much.

Build with us in Copenhagen

• Preferably fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken

• Familiar with engineering best practices, CI/CD, DevOps, testing, and automation

We offer exciting projects, a transparent career framework, certification opportunities, and strong support for your professional growth.
